GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear, held together turn, heded Straightening Up , found little and dropped out # bled

Jumped Ok , Set  solid clip in front 800m, slipped away and had big lead straightening, Just started to feel the pinch last 200m and found a couple better but held on for minor placing # led/overran late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the lead throughout the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 1-2l off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off, kept on fairly after tough run # 3 Wide trip
Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, still 1 length clear approaching 100m b4 headed 50m # found 1 better
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to have bled from both nostrils. Tnr was advised of the provisions of AR79(4).

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Raced keenly until raced 5th Four Wide No Cover (2.5L from lead). Worked to hold ground until pushed out Five Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 250m & faded in last 200m. Rider - didn't feel comfortable late. # Worked/forgive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated that after beginning awkwardly, was reluctant to pressure his mnt as he would have had to make too much use of his mnt to obtain a prominent pos. He rode his mnt in a neutral manner in e/stages in an attempt to find a pos with cover near mid. Unable to find cover & was left racing 4 wide. After shifting wider on the track on straightening, gave limited response when placed under pressure & due to the gelding not feeling comfortable, he did not test over the final 100m. A post race vet exam revealed no abs. Now be spelled. Tnr advised Barrier Trial required PTNS. Trial since

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 2 Wide half clear, under pressure turn and dropped out # poor/amiss?
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Q’d re perf rdr exp mount raced keenly in the early and middle stages and proved reluctant to settle, he added that his mount floundered in the heavy going and was a beaten horse prior to straightening and for this reason he did not test his mount over the concluding stages. A post-race vet- slow to recover. Trnr reported had pulled up well following the event and agreed with the views of rider that rnr had failed to handle the heavy and testing conditions. Trainer undertook to avoid starting the gelding on heavy going for the foreseeable future. On this assurance a warning issued.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: j/pl pressed on to lead 1.5L clear, held together turn, Straightened Up half clear, same 200m, headed passing 100m, kept on well just no match top 2 late # led/headed 100m
Bit Slow Out Went Forward from Outside Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear held together same to straightening up held a margin until the 150m (xovnboff, v/off) # battled final 100m
